name: save-boot-7-world-kalm
description: #80, world map; live check #140. Boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-wm1-kalm.json: module state 3 (world map) with exit action 0, and location 2 (wm1, 'Outside Kalm' in ff7-flat-wiki Field_ID); party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; progress 6 (md1stin's value: no reachable source documents the progress value here). In the decomp (reference only) the title's load copies the state into g_GameState and the exit action into the world map's entry argument, so the world map starts at that entry point, as when a field exit leads there. Load as save-boot-1-load does, but wait for g_GameState 3 (w_state). Then 600 frames for the world map to load. A message window is open at that point and holds the player (#140 attempt 3; save-boot-7h-world-kalm-window), so three Circle presses one second apart close it, then 60 frames, a mark, 60 frames of Down+Left (away from Kalm: holding Up from here ended in field mode in #140 attempts 1 and 3, probably by entering the town) and 10 still. Checks: g_GameState still reads 3 (world_ok); g_FieldCurrentMap still names the entry point (map_ok); the world overlay's player actor pointer D_8010AD40 names pool element 7 (pc_ok: low half 0xA554, #80 attempts 2 and 3); message window 0 is closed (win_ok); the player actor's pos.vx and pos.vz both changed since the mark (x_dir, z_dir: signs only, no coordinate leaves); and a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state (match). wm_id, prev_state and game_state, reported in #80, are no longer reported (8-metric limit; their values are in notes/80-boot-catalogue.md).

game_state.description: g_GameState (s16 as u16; field 1, battle 2, menu 5 confirmed #76).

map_cur.description: g_FieldCurrentMap (s16 as u16; confirmed #77): in the world map, the entry point the save names.

pc_lo.description: World overlay D_8010AD40, the player actor pointer (low half): which element of the actor pool D_80109F34[] (0xE0 bytes each, low halves 0x9F34 + i*0xE0) is the player. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h.

win0.description: g_WindowData[0].state (0x80083274 + 0x2C; s16 as u16): 0 = WSTATE_INIT (no window), 6 = WSTATE_TXT_DONE. Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) config/symbols.main.us.txt, include/game.h WindowData, WindowState.

pos_x.description: Player actor (pool element 7) + 0x0C pos.vx (s32). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h WorldActor; WmGetPosFromPcEntity reads it.

pos_z.description: Player actor + 0x14 pos.vz (s32). Xeeynamo/ff7-decomp@9411173 (reference only, no code) src/world/world.h WorldActor.
